newsitem.title: USA: Stimsonite selling Waukegan, Ill. facility.
newsitem.headline: Stimsonite selling Waukegan, Ill. facility.

text.p: Stimsonite Corp said Monday it entered into a contract to sell its Waukegan, Ill., facility and expects to record a "substantial cash benefit" from the deal, including tax benefits.

In conjunction with the sale, Stimsonite's board of directors authorized the buyback of an additional 500,000 shares, raising total authorized repurchases to one million shares. Under the previous program, the company bought back a total of 407,200 shares at an average price of $6.91 a share, including 81,200 shares during the second quarter.
The sale of the Waukegan facility is expected to close within 30 days.

Stimsonite, which provides highway safety products, said the reserve previously set up to cover the loss on the sale of the facility is expected to be adequate. The building will be sold at a loss, it said.
The cash benefit will come from the conversion of a nonproductive asset into cash, it said.
